page.overview:
Who is Niggurab?

Niggurab, or Nigguraab, is an entity created by Polish comic book creator Len Kaminski for his stint on long-running superhero series Avengers. It was first mentioned in issue #353 in September 1992 .

Niggurab was one of the deities invoked by the supervillain Grim Reaper, who required power to create his Legion of the Undead, an army of zombie-villains with the sole purpose of destroying the Avengers (: Avengers #353) .

It has been speculated that Niggurab is merely another name for the Outer God Shub-Niggurath, rather than its own unique entity .
